reviews.text: SOS Animal promptly welcomed us during a very urgent moment when our dog, Biriba, needed to be hospitalized. Initially, she presented symptoms of possible pneumonia, but her condition worsened, and thanks to the team's agility and competence, we reached a diagnosis in record time. Unfortunately, we discovered a rare, extremely aggressive cancer with no specific treatment, called mesothelioma. Those were very difficult days, with several hospitalizations, drainage of fluids due to pleural effusions, and follow-up with different specialists. But throughout this journey, we had an incredible experience with the clinic. The structure, cleanliness, organization, communication, care for the animals, and especially the agility and commitment of all the professionals were impressive. The team spared no effort to help us, seeking support from other specialists and even external contacts to expedite test results and ensure the best possible care. Our special gratitude to Dr. Laura, the pulmonologist who led the case, and to Dr. Max, the oncologist. Dr. Laura was fundamental throughout this journey, not only for her competence and quick decisions, but also for her affection, warmth, and support during extremely difficult times. Unfortunately, our Biriba is no longer with us. The illness was very aggressive, and everything happened quickly. But we are certain that we were in excellent hands and that, without all this care, this journey could have been even more difficult. We have never had such a complete and welcoming veterinary experience. We recognize in the entire team a great deal of dedication, ethics, professionalism, and, above all, humanity. Our immense gratitude to SOS Animal, especially to Dr. Laura and Dr. Max. You made a difference in the life of our Biriba and our family. We recommend them wholeheartedly and with complete confidence. Thank you so much for everything! ❤️
Great place for our pets.

⭐ My experience with the clinic was extremely painful, and I left without the certainty that everything that could have been done for my dog ​​was done.

Benhur, my 6.2 kg Pinscher, has always been very healthy. He was undergoing cancer treatment for a tumor on his paw and, on August 14th, received his first and only dose of cyclophosphamide, authorized by the oncologist after tests showed normal results.

After chemotherapy, he presented with intestinal inflammation and a slight alteration in the liver, treated with corticosteroids for about a week. After that, he was fine, without pain, with normal appetite and behavior. He also had some vomiting, controlled with medication.

On September 5th, however, he began to vomit and have bloody stools. The ultrasound showed inflammation in the liver, cholecystitis with biliary sludge, intestinal inflammation, gastritis, pancreatic alteration, and cystitis. The blood test from the previous week already showed an ALT of around 1,400.

On September 7th, he was admitted as an urgent case, presenting with jaundice, dehydration, abdominal discomfort, and lack of spontaneous appetite.

On September 8th, an ultrasound showed worsening inflammation in the colon, liver inflammation, gallbladder edema, and pancreatitis. The liver panel showed ALT 1,506, AST 579, ALP 1,110, GGT 37.4, and total bilirubin 6.96, in addition to leukocytes at 26,600.

During the day, according to the report, he was still urinating, calm, and receiving assisted feeding. He did not have any new episodes of bloody diarrhea in the afternoon, and the possibility of discharge the following day was noted if he improved.

However, in the early morning of September 9th, his condition worsened drastically. The report records prostration, poor responsiveness, inability to walk, absence of swallowing reflex, and a temperature of 34.4°C. His blood glucose level was 54, he received glucose, and subsequently had three seizures, treated with diazepam. After a description of "little result," he received intravenous Acepran (acepromazine).

Shortly after, he suffered respiratory arrest, was intubated and placed on manual ventilation, subsequently progressing to cardiorespiratory arrest. Resuscitation maneuvers were unsuccessful. Benhur died at 4:38 AM.

I am not stating that the clinical picture or the cyclophosphamide caused his death. I know he was seriously ill and might not have survived.

But, after reading the report itself, I am left with questions I cannot answer: given the hypoglycemia, seizures, neurological changes, and such rapid deterioration, were all possibilities of treatment and resuscitation truly exhausted?

I left my dog ​​hospitalized precisely so that he would have a better chance of surviving, and I trusted that he would receive the best possible care while I was away.

Today, unfortunately, I no longer have that certainty. And this doubt is one of the most painful parts of losing someone who was part of my family.

I suggest you reconsider hospitalization at this clinic.

It is the place I take all my dogs. I recommend their service. The team are pretty good, and they offer a lot of vet specialities besides plain clinic. And they offer health plans, too. It works 24/7.
Ah, no parking except along the street. But if you have someone to drive you there, they can drop your pet and you on the sidewalk, in front of the clinic.
It is still my dogs' clinic. I am very satisfied with them. Update in May-11- 2026: they are still my clinic :)

My pet had a plan, but I canceled it because I'm only taking him to SOS from now on.
He was hospitalized for 3 days, and from the first appointment, he was well cared for. I felt confident about the treatment plan, and today he's recovered.
During his hospitalization, I received information and photos through a WhatsApp group, and they answered all my questions during the visit.

I have nothing but praise. My dog ​​had a serious health problem and had to stay there for a few days, where she was very well cared for by the entire team (especially Dr. Ana Luiza). Competent and attentive professionals.
Caring and loving care for pets.
Excellent veterinarians and staff. The receptionists are top-notch. They treat our animals with so much love and care. I am so grateful to everyone.

I wanted to thank the SOS Animal team, you are all wonderful. Both the medical team and the nurses!! The receptionists were all polite and attentive. Nurse Marciele, thank you so much! For taking care of my Luck. God bless each and every one of you!! A thousand stars for you all ❤️❤️😘 …
Competent veterinarians and good service.
I've known him for over 17 years.
Very caring and attentive people!

My pet received emergency care from SOS Animal after being violently attacked by a dog. The professionals have given us all the support and care we need.
Thank you so much for all the help and excellent service!

Best veterinary clinic in Tijuca. Receptionists, technicians, veterinarians, and specialists are wonderful and competent. I feel an incredible sense of confidence in their care.
My dog ​​accidentally discovered cancer during a routine exam. From that first moment, we were very welcomed by Dr. Monica, who made herself available to support us and answer any questions. Dr. Gilberto, the surgeon responsible for the two surgeries she needed, was wonderful, attentive, patient, and informative. As for oncology, words cannot describe the professionalism and competence of Dr. Max. He welcomed us during a delicate time, was patient, and very caring with my baby. In addition to these professionals, all the technicians, especially Anderson, were perfect during these last 6 months of struggle. Dr. Juliana from the ultrasound who discovered the tumor, thank you so much!
Much gratitude to everyone at SOS Animal who were so important to Maggie. If I have her here with me today, it's thanks to all of you!

I was very anxious about my pet Zoe's tartar removal surgery and the removal of some of her teeth. When I took her to SOS Animal and Dr. Isabel Guidon (PetOdonto), I felt completely at ease with all the competence and love with which she treated my Zoe. She explained every detail of the surgery, as well as the post-operative period. My Zoe gained a better quality of life. I thank Dr. Isabel Guidon, who is a 1000/10, Dr. Luciane Crevelario (anesthesiologist), who is a lovely person, and Dr. Cararina (cardiologist), who is very patient and attentive. Take your pets there. Excellent and competent clinic and doctors.

I recently discovered the clinic. But I haven't used the service much, only for vaccinations. I visited the clinic and found it very well-structured. The veterinarians and receptionists are very attentive.

I would like to express my gratitude to the SOS Animais team for the care they gave my dog ​​during his hospitalization.

Those were difficult days, but at all times I was treated with great sensitivity and respect. The team demonstrated a high level of professionalism, combined with humane care that made all the difference. I always felt safe regarding the treatment and very well informed about his condition, which brought peace of mind during such a delicate time.

I especially want to highlight the professionals who were directly involved in his care: extremely attentive, dedicated and caring, they treated not only my dog ​​with affection, but also showed me a sensitive approach.

I am very grateful for all the support and I strongly recommend the work of SOS Animais.

Excellent service from both the doctors and the staff. I've known the clinic for over 20 years; Dr. Luis has always been my dogs' veterinarian, and this was the first time I needed to hospitalize them. Treatment, food, follow-up, attention, affection—everything was wonderful, just as I expected. The trust they inspire in us gives us peace of mind regarding our four-legged children. The care from the staff, who provide daily updates twice a day with photos, is excellent! Congratulations to everyone for their dedication!

The clinic has a super attentive and professional team. From reception to nursing and the veterinarians. Besides the human aspect, the facilities are top-notch. Jatobá is 15 years old and is followed by Dr. Gilberto. He has already had tartar removal and the removal of a skin lesion that required electrochemotherapy. This week, he needed surgery to remove his spleen, which had tumors. His recovery is going great! I thank the entire team for their attention and care for my senior dog. 🐶

S.O.S Animal saved my dog, who passed away a year ago but lived to be almost 20 years old, and today they take care of my Galguinho with so much love, with wonderful professionals! I highly recommend them. Thank you all.

I took my dog ​​to the clinic, where she was diagnosed with pancreatitis and other inflammations in her gastrointestinal system. She needed to be hospitalized, and the care she received was excellent. The consultations, exams, and all the follow-up before, during, and after hospitalization were incredible.

All the professionals involved treated Gaia with extreme attention and care. Furthermore, information regarding her health condition was sent daily via WhatsApp, which helped to put my mind at ease.

I especially thank Dr. Hellena, who managed the entire process with great professionalism and provided Gaia with the appropriate treatment so that she could recover as quickly as possible.

I highly recommend them ❤️
I left my Golden Retriever in the veterinary care of the SOS team, and all I can say is that the professionals are very efficient and caring. I recommend SOS Animal.
I didn't have a good experience with my dog, which resulted in unnecessary expenses. That's according to the veterinarian in our city. As for the service, I have no complaints.

My experience with this clinic couldn't have been better; they saved my pet who was almost dead.
There was dedication, courage, and very competent work. I will never forget it! Thank you for everything ❤️‍🔥 …
The veterinarians were very attentive. My dog ​​needed to be hospitalized, and I was very pleased with the procedures.

My dog ​​has been treated at the clinic since she was a puppy, and has had the clinic's health plan for about 6 years, which somewhat mitigates the costs. Even so, the professionals are worth the price, as they offer efficient and respectful care, which is fundamental.
She receives all her vaccinations at the clinic, most of which are included in the plan, and consults with the excellent veterinarians: Dr. Gilberto and Dr. Monica. I also want to highlight Dr. Mariele!
The waiting time is quite reasonable, the facilities are good, the reception staff is good, and the nurses are very helpful.
In short, we are very satisfied with the clinic.

Today I want to express my sincerest gratitude and praise to the entire SOS Animal team for Kira's hospitalization.
In a moment of such concern, we found extremely dedicated, attentive, and humane professionals. Every act of care, every piece of guidance, and every gesture of affection made all the difference — not only for Kira's recovery but also to calm our hearts.
It is comforting to know that there are still people who practice their profession with so much love and responsibility. You were fundamental in this process, and I will be eternally grateful for everything.
Thank you so much for taking such good care of our little one. 💛🐾
At SOS Animal, my pet was cared for by excellent professionals and received all the attention, support, and affection it deserved.

Good morning Ms. Ana, I see from the registration that it was with the animal Pongo, who had ingested some human medication tablets improperly. He was relatively well and some tests were requested to assess possible side effects, but unfortunately you did not agree and we have not had any further contact since. To improve our relationship, I would like to know what was unsatisfactory in the service that led to this negative review.
Thank you for your feedback.

Every time my kitten needs care, I don't hesitate. SOS always attends to me with wonderful professionals, solely concerned with the health of our pet. He always gets better. A big thank you and admiration to the inpatient staff and to Dr. Mariele, who save countless lives daily, and especially my kitten's. 💛 …
Excellent veterinary clinic with a diverse range of professionals available in various specialties. Offers health insurance.

Our animals have been cared for at SOS Animal for over 20 years.
We have always been very well received; everyone is polite and helpful.
They are very affectionate with the animals and do everything for their well-being.
My dog ​​was recently hospitalized and, as always, the care was exemplary.
She continues treatment and, without a doubt, there is no better place for it.
The clinic and all its doctors and staff are exceptional! My experience has always been one of impeccable service. My gratitude goes to the entire SOS Animal team ❤️

So far my experiences with the clinic have been excellent! I had a dog hospitalized for gastrointestinal problems and he was very well treated, and another dog was followed by Dr. Ana Luiza, who is a gastroenterologist and also very good. The ultrasound technician is also excellent, and everyone is very kind and careful.
Excellent experience! Competent professionals who inspire confidence! I recommend them!
Excellent clinic, diverse specialties, and top-notch service.

The clinic was recommended to us by our dogs' veterinarian (we have 2 Chihuahuas). I've had to take them there in two separate emergencies and they were well cared for, treated with the necessary urgency and empathy. The clinic also has hospitalization facilities. I thank the entire team for their good work and recommend them to anyone who needs their services.

I had an excellent experience. I was in the emergency room yesterday with my dog, who had been unwell for three days and was getting worse after two days of unsatisfactory care at another clinic in the neighborhood. After an exhausting weekend, watching my little companion suffer and not respond to the recommendations of the veterinarians at the previous clinic, we received very complete, committed, and humane care from Dr. Mariele Stamm. The doctor, who is also a nutritionist, was extremely affectionate and patient with my dog ​​and with us, who were distressed and tired. She explained everything very calmly, answered our questions very completely, and administered medications that truly brought him relief. In addition, she gave us very effective recommendations for home care. The doctor was very willing to follow up on the progress of the care and also made a point of contacting the veterinarian who has been caring for my dog ​​for a long time. I am happy with the care; I feel that my dog ​​finally received the attention he deserves at this very delicate time. My thanks to the professionals at the clinic, especially Dr. Mariele Stamm. Marielle!

We would like to express our gratitude to Dr. Mariele, who cared for our kitten Twix with so much love and affection. She helped us understand that losing him wasn't something we could control, but the end of the pain was. Thank you! Glória and Eduardo

My father's cat underwent surgery at this clinic for a very serious kidney problem, and I also took a rescued cat there who only needed to stay for one day because they quickly stabilized his condition. In both cases, I witnessed extreme competence. The price is indeed high, but it's worth it, especially when it comes to the lives of our animals. Unfortunately, my dog, who contracted tick-borne disease, was hospitalized at another clinic because it was closer to my house and I didn't realize the severity of the illness. She died within a few days because she didn't receive the proper treatment, but I have a strong feeling that if I had taken her to SOS Animal, she would have had a better chance of fighting the disease and surviving.

The clinic's service is spectacular! Dr. Leonardo received us with great care and attention to my dog ​​Ariel. Unfortunately, we had to return, but again she was very well cared for by the on-call doctor, the cardiology team, and all the nurses. An excellent clinic that surprised me with its dedication, professionalism, and, above all, the care with which they treat our pets.
My dog, who was having difficulty breathing, was actually in a lot of pain due to a urinary problem. The treatment was quick and efficient, although it was relatively expensive.

The staff are very attentive and Dr. Isabel (the dentist) is an excellent professional.
Pleasant environment.
Excellent service for your pet.
Excellent veterinary clinic, very pleasant environment, wonderful professionals in all areas.

My mother took her cat to this place; he suffered a serious eye injury, a cut that was infected and bleeding. She received very poor treatment; they didn't pay the slightest attention to the animal, said he would have to see an ophthalmologist, and prescribed eye drops for conjunctivitis, C O N J U N T I V I T I S. After 7 days of use and no improvement, we went to another veterinarian, who immediately said that the wrong eye drops had been prescribed and gave us the appropriate ones. In other words, I do not recommend this place! Expensive, negligent service, and wrong diagnosis!
They saved my dog. Excellent clinic. Thank you so much to all the veterinarians, they were super attentive.
Excellent service. And the veterinarians are great professionals and very helpful.

On June 14th, 2025, my pet Bartholomeu received excellent care in the emergency room from Dr. Mariele and Dr. Mariana (ultrasound). I would like to thank and praise the excellent treatment provided, as well as the clinic's facilities, which are great!

Excellent clinic. Accurate diagnoses and successful treatments.
It is worth highlighting the excellent professionals: Dr. Luis and Dr. Gilberto.
The only thing missing is offering internship opportunities for veterinary medicine students.

Yesterday I took my cat to the clinic for the first time and I left extremely satisfied. Impeccable service from the moment we arrived, and the professionals inspired confidence. The veterinarians Aline and Juliana, who performed the ultrasound, took good care of my kitten, who has already started treatment!
Excellent
Excellent service.

SOS Animal is a very unique veterinary clinic. All employees are extremely well-trained. Veterinarians, nurses, assistants, receptionists, in short, all the clinic's employees are extremely competent, attentive, and caring.
Before I knew SOS Animal, I was very afraid of the day I would need to hospitalize an animal.
After I got to know the clinic, I needed to hospitalize my two dogs, Thor and Zeus, a few times, and I never had that fear again, because the trust was total and unrestricted. Even when the inevitable moment of farewell arrived, SOS Animal played a fundamental role in ensuring the most dignified departure a pet can have. It is important to mention that the respect and care extend invaluably to the owners in a moment of profound grief. Immensely grateful to the clinic, the veterinarians, and every employee who was part of my journey with my beloved Thor and Zeus.

I really liked the SOS Animal clinic in Tijuca! I've been there several times and I'm always very well attended to, both via WhatsApp and in person by the clinic's receptionists. My two cats have already had several exams at this clinic and all the veterinarians and nurses were very attentive, I was very satisfied!
Service is on a first-come, first-served basis; they could also offer the option of scheduling an appointment.
Everyone was very attentive!
Best clinic in Rio de Janeiro!
I received excellent care in emergency situations. Dr. Marielle is very attentive and prioritizes the well-being of animals. She also helped me through a difficult situation with my cat.
Very attentive team.
Attentive service.
I've been taking my cats there for over 5 years. I like the entire team, from the receptionists to the veterinarians.

Excellent professionals, personalized care for both dog and owner, and they even have their own health plan for small dogs, which is totally worth it. I recommend Dr. Marielle and dermatologist Dr. Mariana.
I don't have a pet, but I took a client there and she loved the service.
Excellent clinic for our beloved pets.
Fast and efficient service.
Care, professionalism, and attention to patients. Excellent facilities!
Excellent veterinarians and good service overall.
Excellent veterinarian.

It's a clinic where we take our dogs, and we're always well taken care of (both humans and dogs). They have a lot of affection for the animals, and the service is always cordial and professional. One of our dogs needed oncological treatment, and it was very important. Dr. Taiane is our dogs' doctor. Dr. Max is also an excellent professional (oncology).

Best vet in Rio!!!!

They are honest and very competent!!! …
